note: Catalog of lazily-fetched models (ADR-011). Weights are never bundled. Each entry's 'license' and 'commercial' fields drive the Phase 4 export license gate.

models.name: openWakeWord melspectrogram (16 kHz log-Mel front-end)
models.notes: Shared Mel front-end; same params as the MCU model so features match.

models.name: Google speech_embedding backbone (re-implemented in openWakeWord)
models.notes: ~1.4M params; MCU-friendly; frozen feature backbone shared by tiny classifiers.

models.name: openWakeWord 'alexa' pre-trained model (DEMO ONLY)
models.notes: Non-commercial. Usable for in-browser demo only; NEVER exported commercially. Phase 4 gate blocks it; Phase 5 trains a clean replacement.

models.name: WavLM-base-plus encoder (int8, Few-Shot backbone)
models.notes: Frozen universal speech encoder for Few-Shot prototype matching. ~95M params.

models.name: Silero VAD (voice activity detection)
models.notes: Gates KWS to reduce compute and false alarms.

models.name: microWakeWord demo model (e.g. 'okay_nabu')
models.notes: Used as a browser-demo MCU model until Phase 5 trains a WaveStudio-owned word.
